title: Oily Outstanding Korean Beef Noodles
description: A pungent and snappy Korean dish featuring beef stock concentrate, this recipe is perfect for those looking for a sugar-free-friendly meal option. It is made with a rich beef broth and served with noodles and various toppings.
instructions: In a large pot, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook until fragrant.
Add the beef bones and cook until browned.
Add the beef stock concentrate and 4 cups of water to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 hour.
Cook the noodles according to the package instructions.
Strain the broth and discard the solids.
Serve the noodles in the hot broth and garnish with green onions and sesame seeds.
Let it cool slightly before serving.
Use a bain-marie to keep the dish warm if desired.
